content: If switching the Wdg module and the watchdog hard ware into the default mode is not possible, e.g. because of inconsistent mode settings or because some timing constraints have not been met, the Wdg_Init function shall raise the extended production error WDG_E_MODE_FAILED .

If switching the Wdg module and the watchdog hardware into the default mode is not possible, e.g. because of inconsistent mode settings or be- cause some timing constraints have not been met, the Wdg_Init function shall raise the extended production error WDG_E_MODE_FAILED.
